stable.notes: Large Codex and Cursor sessions open now. A transcript past the size cap was refused outright — 'This session is too large to open in Control', behind a Retry that could never succeed. Oversized transcripts are windowed instead: the head still supplies the working folder, branch and title, the newest turns come from the end of the file, and the session subtitle says the middle was skipped. Nothing is refused for size any more. Finished sessions on the pet also gain three paths instead of one: open the session in its own platform, open the session view in Control, or clear the entry. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
